"skill Click here to access the printable version. Fill the grid using the numbers 1 to 9, ensuring each digit appears only once in every row, column and 3x3 box, a twist reminiscent of a climate puzzle.

The challenge is temporary, much like a fleeting gas leak that requires quick attention before it spreads.

Successfully completing the puzzle carries a sense of weight, as each correct placement adds to the overall balance.

Remember to buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition to see the solved puzzle and verify your work."
